# http-response-status-code

> Zero-dependency HTTP status code utility with names, reason phrases, validators, and Fetch / Web Standard response helpers for TypeScript & JavaScript.

## Overview
`http-response-status-code` provides typed constants for all RFC 9110 HTTP status codes, lookup helpers, category validators, and a `toResponseInit` helper compatible with the standard Fetch API `ResponseInit`.

## Installation
```bash
npm install http-response-status-code
```

## Quick Start
```typescript
import {
  OK,
  CREATED,
  BAD_REQUEST,
  NOT_FOUND,
  INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
  toResponseInit,
  isClientError,
  getStatusName,
  getStatusDescription,
} from "http-response-status-code";

// Status code constants (typed numbers)
console.log(OK); // 200
console.log(NOT_FOUND); // 404

// Fetch API / Web Standard ResponseInit helper
const response = new Response(
  JSON.stringify({ message: "Item created" }),
  toResponseInit(CREATED, {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
  })
);

// Category validators
isClientError(404); // true
isClientError(200); // false

// Lookups
getStatusName(418); // "IM_A_TEAPOT"
getStatusDescription(500); // "Internal Server Error"
```

## API Reference

### Status Code Constants
Every standard status code is exported as an uppercase named constant:
- `OK` (200), `CREATED` (201), `ACCEPTED` (202), `NO_CONTENT` (204)
- `MOVED_PERMANENTLY` (301), `FOUND` (302), `NOT_MODIFIED` (304)
- `BAD_REQUEST` (400), `UNAUTHORIZED` (401), `FORBIDDEN` (403), `NOT_FOUND` (404), `CONFLICT` (409), `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` (422), `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` (429)
- `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` (500), `BAD_GATEWAY` (502), `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (503), `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` (504)

### Web Standards Helper
- `toResponseInit(code: number | string, init?: Record<string, unknown>): IResponseInit`
  Returns an object `{ status, statusText, ...init }` ready to pass directly to `new Response(body, init)` in Next.js, Remix, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Express, Fastify, etc.

### Validators
- `isInformational(code: number): boolean` (100–199)
- `isSuccess(code: number): boolean` (200–299)
- `isRedirectional(code: number): boolean` (300–399)
- `isClientError(code: number): boolean` (400–499)
- `isServerError(code: number): boolean` (500–599)
- `isValidStatusCode(code: number): boolean`

### Metadata Lookups
- `getStatusCode(name: string): number` (e.g. `"NOT_FOUND"` -> 404)
- `getStatusName(code: number): string` (e.g. 404 -> `"NOT_FOUND"`)
- `getStatusDescription(code: number): string` (e.g. 404 -> `"Not Found"`)

## Guidelines for AI Coding Agents
1. Use named constants (e.g. `BAD_REQUEST`, `NOT_FOUND`) instead of magic numbers.
2. When creating Web Standard responses, use `toResponseInit(STATUS_CODE, { headers })`.
3. Use `isClientError(status)` or `isServerError(status)` to branch error handling logic cleanly.
